sync.title: Local backup
sync.description: Write resumes into a folder you choose. The browser reads and writes it directly — no server involved.

faq.title: Questions
faq.description: A few common questions about storage and export.

storage.a: In this browser’s localStorage under toolbox.resume. A linked folder adds one JSON file per resume. Clearing browser data deletes them — keep your own backup.

pagedExport.q: How is Export PDF different from browser print?
pagedExport.a: Both PDF exports rasterise the resume, so text is not selectable. Browser print uses the system layout engine: text stays selectable and can still be saved as PDF.

templateSwitch.q: Does switching templates change my styling?
templateSwitch.a: Yes. A template applies its own accent colour and section/paragraph/page spacing so the design stays intact. Re-adjust them in the left panel afterwards.

remotePhoto.q: Why is my linked photo missing from the export?
remotePhoto.a: Without a backend proxy the browser cannot read pixels of a cross-origin image, so export skips it (it still displays on screen). Upload the image as a file instead.

ai.entryHint: When off, the polish and proofreading entries are hidden and Import PDF is greyed out. When on, content goes straight to the provider you configure here.
ai.notConfigured: No usable AI model yet. Add a key and pick a model under AI providers first.

config.title: AI provider settings
config.pickHint: Configure several providers; pick one to edit it here.
config.notice: The key stays in this browser local storage and requests go straight from your browser to the address you set. This site neither proxies nor stores it.
config.baseUrlHint: You can point this at your own relay. A wrong address means the request never lands.
config.modelPlaceholder: Type a model name, e.g. deepseek-chat
config.textHint: Each provider keeps its own text and vision pick, so configuring one never overwrites another. The provider that actually runs is the one chosen at the top. The vision slot feeds PDF import, so the model you name there has to read images on its own or the import fails.
config.fetchEmpty: That endpoint returned no models. Use "Type a model name" and fill it in.
config.listEmpty: Start with "Fetch models" at the top right. If that endpoint is unsupported, choose "Type a model name" and fill it in.

test.mismatch: The reply did not match what was expected
test.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot create a canvas, so the vision check is unavailable

polish.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. more formal tone, highlight measurable results

status.ready: The text in this field is sent to the model; you can replace it wholesale afterwards.
status.finished: Done. Apply once you have checked it.

pdf.needVisionModel: PDF import needs a vision-capable model. Configure one first.
pdf.previewHint: This is what the model read. Confirming creates a new resume.

consent.title: Turn on AI assist?
consent.body: Once on, polishing, proofreading and PDF import send your resume content directly to the provider you configured, never through this site. Resume text is personal information; make sure you accept that.

errors.modelAccessDenied: This key has no access to that model.
